newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Winsor Ind completes property demerger.
newsitem.headline: Winsor Ind completes property demerger.

text.p: Winsor Industrial Corp Ltd said the demerger of its property interests to Winsor Properties Holdings Ltd (WPHL) had been completed and trading in WPHL shares would begin on November 8.

The company announced earlier this month that WPHL would acquire Winsor Industrial's properties by way of an issue of 129.84 million WPHL shares to Winsor Industrial, which would distribute the shares it receives to Winsor Industrial shareholders by way of a special interim dividend.
Winsor Industrial said its adjusted net tangible assets after the demerger totalled about HK$980 million.
It said retained profit carried forward for the period from April 1 to October 30 was HK$119.52 million.
